screening: S0: window sampling, weighted CE, 96 stretch, per-frame crop, no augmentation
S1: change S0 to uniform original-interval sampling and random internal window
S2: change S1 to unweighted CE
Choose loss between S1/S2 by validation clip Macro-F1, earliest experiment wins ties

test_rule: no candidate test evaluation until freeze.json exists and remaining independent seed training finishes; evaluate all 6 frozen finalists, never select by test results
metric_policy: fixed 5-class macro, zero division=0; masked known-frame segment IoU/Edit, interval-valued GT boundary tolerance16 frames
